messages:
maria-marketing: Quick sync  We need final changelog URL + canonical docs link for the launch post. Canary to APAC then global after 2h, correct? :hourglass:

sam-eng: Yes. Changelog: https://docs.redwood.inference/release/2026-03-23-changelog (stable). Canonical docs: https://docs.redwood.inference/launch/2026-03-optimize. Canary YAML ready if you want it.

maria-marketing: Paste the YAML and a short benchmark line for the headline. Our PR copy wants latency@256 and a cost delta.

sam-eng: YAML: ```rollout:
  canary:
    start: "2026-03-23T11:00:00-07:00"
    regions: ["apac"]
    initial_pct: 5
    step_pct: 10
    promote_after: 2h
  global_promote: "2026-03-23T13:00:00-07:00"```

ellie-product: Headline blurb: "95th pctl latency @256 tokens (gpu-a100, int8): 42ms; ~3.1x cost reduction vs fp16." I'll drop a 2-paragraph bench callout in 20m.

nate-growth: Webinar set for 14:30 PDT (about 90m after promote). I'll wire registration and embed on the post.

jon-sre: Webhook routing ready. On changelog publish deploy-bot triggers /support/lead-route and tags enterprise when company_size>200. Example payload added to playbook.

deploy-bot: Scheduled publish hook set for 2026-03-23T10:00:00-07:00. If assets change after 09:30 PDT ping #release-war-room.

maria-marketing: Great. I'll assemble the final blog draft and post it here for a quick read before publish. :rocket:
